title: Falls Church Indoor Air: Corridor Dust vs Household Debris
headline: Broad Street lots, I-66 grit, and why the independent city is not the huge Census name
description: The City of Falls Church sits on small lots next to the Beltway and Route 7. An educational look at why older trunks collect traffic dust.

sections.heading: Second-floor laundry on a small lot is a long, bent vent
paragraphs: Many close-in houses put the dryer on the second floor and send lint on a crooked path to a rear wall. Elbows pack. The closet stays hot. Humidity from that vent sits in the same small envelope as the leaking older trunks.
If supplies look dirty a few days after you wipe them, when you are ready to book, use the [Falls Church, VA location page](/locations/falls-church).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Falls Church house
listItems: Gray film on supplies facing Broad Street or the Beltway side of the lot.
Dust returning quickly in a 1920s–60s house with later central air.
A hot upstairs laundry closet and long dry times.

sections.heading: This page is the independent city — not the sprawling Census label
paragraphs: The City of Falls Church is small: Broad Street, Washington Street, Tinner Hill, and tight blocks of 1920s–60s houses. That is a different place from the huge “Falls Church” name that sprawls through Fairfax County. Short yards put returns close to the film that coats porches along Route 7. I-66 and the Beltway add brake dust. Street trees add pollen. Returns pull all of it.
A house that gained central air later often has trunks snaked through tight joist bays. Dust collects at those kinks. You wipe a register. The next commute week puts the film back.

listItems: Change filters more often if you sit on Route 7 or I-66 air.
Keep basement humidity under 50% in summer.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear bent dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: What usually causes gray film on supply registers?
faq.a: Fine particles that bypass or overload filters settle in cool trunks and recirculate when the blower runs.

faq.q: When is dryer vent cleaning the better first step?
faq.a: When laundry closets stay hot, dry times double, or you smell burnt lint — clear the vent to the exterior cap.
